name: Knight of the Fen
_source: Monster Sheet, AI/BP/Trait cards, Signature, Routine — owner scans (readings owner-confirmed 2026-11-15); Clash Setup: Sunken Kingdom Codex p.42–43

footprint.rear: the two cells behind (R on the sheet diagram)

traits.name: One with the Swamp
traits.text: Dwell: Move the Monster miniature to the closest unoccupied space on a Swamp Terrain tile.

traits.name: We Are Many
traits.text: Whenever the Knight of the Fen is dealt a Wound, (a Double Wound is treated as 2 Wounds) place a Generic token on this Trait. After you finish resolving the current action, if there are 4 or more Generic tokens on this Trait, discard all Generic tokens, Spawn a Doppelknight on the closest Swamp Terrain tile that doesn’t have a Doppelknight on it, and perform Signature.

traits.name: Doppelknight
traits.text:
Start of Clash: Spawn a Doppelknight on a Swamp Terrain tile closest to Knight of the Fen.

When Spawning a Doppelknight, place its token on the designated space in a Mob base ring with the lowest available number. Then, take the top card of the BP deck and place it face down on the leftmost empty space on the Mob track—this is the Doppelknight’s BP card.

Doppelknights are Mobs without Activation tokens (they can still activate, see the Doppelganger Trait). They have Advanced Bypass, Odd Spawn, and the same To Hit [To Hit] value as Knight of the Fen. After wounding a Doppelknight BP, place it on the Wound Stack, remove the Doppelknight token, and place a 1x2 Swamp Terrain tile on its space. Escalate as if you dealt a Wound to Knight of the Fen. When a Knight is involuntarily moved onto a Doppelknight token, they are Displaced and gain the Slimed Condition card.

If at any point there are no cards in the BP deck and discard pile, you immediately lose the Clash!

traits.name: Ooze Trap
traits.text:
Additional Setup: Place the Engulfed Trait card near the Monster Sheet.
When Knight of the Fen or Doppelknight moves through a space with a Knight on it, that Knight doesn’t suffer Crash, but gains the Slimed Condition card instead.

Level 2–3: They additionally lose -2 [Vigor].
When Knight of the Fen ends its movement on a Knight, that Knight becomes Engulfed (place your miniature on Engulfed Trait card and gain the Slimed Condition card).

traits.name: Doppelganger
traits.text: All Doppelknights activate after Knight of the Fen, starting from the lowest number on the Mob track, and perform Attacks using the Doppelganger effect on the drawn AI card (if there’s any), using the same Evasion stats. If a Doppelknight doesn’t have a valid Target during its Activation, skip its Attack. If there’s a Chain Break during Knight of the Fen’s or Doppelknight’s Activation, do not activate any more Doppelknights during that Monster Round.

traits.name: Spread Thin
traits.text: Every Doppelknight on the Clash Board lowers Knight of the Fen’s [AT] by 1, to a minimum of 1.

traits.name: Living Wasteheap
traits.text:
All Knights gain “Crit Miss: Discard a chosen Gear [Gear] card and place it on the Living Wasteheap Trait.”
The Knight of the Fen gains the following benefits depending on the Gear [Gear] cards on this Trait:
For every Weapon: Knight of the Fen’s Attacks additionally cause -1 [Vigor] loss.
Whenever Armor is placed: Place 2 Armor [Armor] tokens on the Sheet.
For every Support: Knight of the Fen gains +1 [To Hit].

traits.name: Absorb the Fallen
traits.text: When a Doppelknight dies, place an Armor [Armor] token on the Monster Sheet.

traits.name: Concentrated Strength
traits.text:
When spawning a Doppelknight, resolve it as normal, except take the top 2 BP cards instead of 1, and place them in a face down stack on the leftmost empty space on the Mob track. If you cannot (i.e. when there’s only 1 card left in the BP deck), you lose the Clash!
When you would reveal a Doppelknight BP, reveal both of its BP cards (keep them in the same order).
When attacking a Doppelknight, if your Total Power exceeds the summed [AT] of both BPs, you Wound both cards and resolve the Critical Response. Otherwise, you fail to wound either card, and must resolve the Fail or Instinct Response. Resolve all Attack Responses, as well as Overcome or Overpower effects only from the top BP card in the stack. Always Escalate the top wounded BP first.

traits.name: We Are Legion
traits.text:
Disable the Spread Thin Trait.

Start of Clash: Spawn an additional Doppelknight on a Swamp Terrain tile closest to Knight of the Fen.

traits.name: Inescapable Slime
traits.text:
Disable the Ooze Trap Trait.
When Knight of the Fen moves through a Knight, that Knight doesn’t suffer Crash and becomes Engulfed instead.
When a Doppelknight moves through a Knight, that Knight gains the Slimed Condition card and loses -2 [Vigor].

traits.name: Quick Summons
traits.text: [Kingdom Trait — Sunken Kingdom] When you Spawn a Doppelknight, the closest Knight gains the Exposed Condition card.

traits.name: Recycled Armor
traits.text: [Kingdom Trait — Principality of Stone] Each time a Doppelknight moves through or ends its movement on a Swamp Terrain tile, it gains an Armor [Armor] token.

traits.name: Engulfed
traits.text:
When you become Engulfed, place your miniature on this card and gain the Slimed Condition card. During your turn, you can either try to Sabotage or attack. You can use only Melee Weapons while Engulfed.

[Wound icon] When you deal a Wound, additionally to normal Responses, you become free (Displace).

[Combat action] or 3 [Heat] Sabotage: Test Fortitude [Fortitude] or Might [Might] (10+). If you succeed, immediately AI Suppress or discard all Armor [Armor] tokens.
End of your turn: If you started your turn Engulfed, Poison 2.

clashSetup._source: Sunken Kingdom Codex p.42–43 (Knight of the Fen Clash)
steps: Monster Positioning: Place the Knight of the Fen miniature on the space designated on the diagram. Note the facing direction indicated by the arrow.

Additional Setup: Place the Engulfed Trait card and 6 Doppleknight tokens near the Monster Sheet. Depending on the Kingdom, take the Recycled Armor (Principality of Stone) or Quick Summons (Sunken Kingdom) Trait card.
notes: 지형·시작 칸은 코덱스 도식에서 읽음 (소유자 확인 2026-11-15)

rulings: Doppelknights: Mobs without Activation tokens on the board with a face-down BP taken from the top of the BP deck; attacked like a Mob (To Hit = Knight of the Fen); wounding one puts its BP on the Wound Stack (counts toward the kill, Escalation as usual), removes the token and places a 1x2 Swamp on its space. Killing a Doppelknight also adds We Are Many tokens (owner reference sheet KotF v1.1, 2026-11-15); the BP cards added by that Escalation go into the BP deck as usual

Doppelknight Spawn location: Start of Clash / Routine → the Swamp tile closest to the Knight of the Fen; We Are Many → closest to the attacking Knight (reference sheet); BP-response Spawns ("the closest Swamp") → also closest to the attacking Knight [해석, 확인 필요]. Odd Spawn = spawns at trait-specified times (rulebook box, owner scan 2026-11-15)

Reference sheet KotF v1.1 (2026-11-15): Engulfed End-of-turn Poison 2 only while still on the Engulfed card; the Displace after wounding while Engulfed is involuntary (no Slimed/Drowning trigger) and kills if no adjacent space is free; Ooze Trap Level 2–3 -2 Vigor also applies when Engulfed by the Monster ending its move on the Knight

Doppelganger: after every AI / Signature card the Knight of the Fen performs (Monster Round, We Are Many, "Perform AI" responses), each Doppelknight in number order performs the card's Doppelganger effect with the same Evasion dice / difficulty (소유자 확인 2026-11-15)

Tornado of Blades Doppelganger "Repeat this Attack against another Target (once)": each Doppelknight performs the card's own attack once against a Knight other than the original Target (소유자 확인 2026-11-15)
Routine Dopplergenesis "perform AI for each Doppelknight": one AI card is drawn per Doppelknight and that Doppelknight performs its Doppelganger effect (소유자 확인 2026-11-15)
Armor tokens "on the Sheet" (Living Wasteheap, Absorb the Fallen): each gives the Knight of the Fen +1 AT; "discard X Armor tokens" removes them (소유자 확인 2026-11-15)

Engulfed: the Knight leaves the board (cannot be targeted, moved or adjacent-checked), may only attack the Knight of the Fen (melee) or Sabotage (Sabotage once per turn — it is one action); Sabotage = d10 + Fortitude or Might vs 10+; freed (Displace next to the Monster) on dealing a Wound; End of turn: Poison 2 (소유자 확인 2026-11-15)

Ooze Trap: moving through a Knight gives Slimed instead of Crash (Level 2–3: also -2 Vigor); a Knight under the Monster when it stops becomes Engulfed. Level 4 (Inescapable Slime): any Knight it moves through becomes Engulfed
Dwell: the Monster moves (normal movement) until its base covers the closest unoccupied Swamp space (소유자 확인 2026-11-15)

Concentrated Strength (Level 3+): Total Power must EXCEED the summed AT of both BPs (incl. level bonus and Armor tokens on the Mob) to wound both; responses of BOTH cards resolve top to bottom, except Attack Responses (Signature / AI attacks) and Overcome / Overpower, which come only from the top card (소유자 확인 2026-11-15)
"For each hit lose -1 Vigor and Poison 1": Poison 1 per hit (소유자 확인 2026-11-15); Heat-gate "GAIN THE SLIMED CONDITION CARD" (Tornado of Blades) applies when the attack hits (소유자 확인 2026-11-15)
Range Attack N: the Target must be within N spaces; "MOVE & RANGE ATTACK 2" moves until within 2 (소유자 확인 2026-11-15)
Living Wasteheap Crit Miss = natural 1 on the Crit die of the Attack Roll; the Knight chooses the Gear card (소유자 확인 2026-11-15)
Lose condition: no cards in the BP deck and discard pile (checked whenever a BP card is drawn or wounded)
